svg.title: Adaptive keypoint extractor, progressive correspondence aligner, structural localization and refinement stage architecture
svg.desc: Complete native SVG reconstruction. Base frames: f01 contains adaptive keypoint extractor with origin Q0 keypoints, cuboid axes, image, voxel net, feature lattice, attention stack, repeated layers and red projection rays; f02 contains progressive correspondence aligner with image/voxel feature input, staged correspondence chain, residual/keypoint streams and right-side projected support; f03 contains confidence-aware structural localization with two graph structures, confidence predictor, sampled keypoint-feature channels, MLP regressor and head; f04 contains dashed refinement stage with two inputs, plus node, positional encoding MLP, attention blocks, deformable attention, offset MLP and output flows. Symmetry/equipartition: panels are horizontally aligned in two rows; stage blocks are arranged on horizontal processing streams with vertical residual branches.
